title: Universal interpolation for deep residual self-attention networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.01981v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Universal approximation is a necessary qualitative property of learning architectures to benefit from scaling laws. While it is generically verified on a variety of neural architectures and random feature models, it typically involves infinite width limits. In this work, we focus on deep self-attention models and consider instead the `dual' regime, where approximation power is enabled entirely by depth, and featuring strong parameter sharing across layers, motivated by recent models such as the Looped Transformers. More specifically, we ask whether one can find a predefined finite set of parameters, each defining an attention block, such that the resulting finite set of transformations can map any collection of $N$ sequences of $n$ tokens to any other collection of $N$ sequences of $n$ tokens. translated_title: 深度残差自注意力网络的通用插值
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.01981v1 公告类型：新 摘要：通用逼近是学习架构能够从缩放定律中受益的必要定性性质。虽然这一性质在多种神经架构和随机特征模型上得到了普遍验证，但其证明通常涉及无限宽度极限。在这项工作中，我们聚焦于深度自注意力模型，转而考虑“对偶”机制，即逼近能力完全由深度实现，并在层间具有强参数共享，这一思路受到诸如循环Transformer等近期模型的启发。更具体地说，我们探究是否可以找到一个预先定义的有限参数集合，其中每个参数定义一个注意力块，使得由此得到的有限变换集合能够将任意由N个序列、每个序列含n个token组成的集合映射到任意其他的此类集合。关键在于，这些变换是独立于输入和输出集合而预先固定的：只有块被应用的顺序……
tldr: 该论文证明了深度残差自注意力网络在“深度即容量”的对偶机制下具备通用插值能力：仅用一组预先固定、与输入输出无关且跨层共享参数的注意力块，通过调整其应用顺序即可将任意token序列集合映射为任意其他序列集合。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes universal interpolation for deep residual self-attention networks in a depth-driven "dual" regime: a fixed, input-independent set of shared-parameter attention blocks, applied in appropriate orders, can map any collection of token sequences to any other.
